answer: Trace attestation binds execution directly to bare metal. Each agent pipes layer computations into discrete TPM registers at every model vertex. This cryptographic haven signs sequential PCR deltas alongside monotonic hardware nonces. Verifiers check counter monotonicity against non-virtualized bus latency; duplicate roots or timing stalls immediately abort proof and burn staked tokens. Simulating 500 concurrent agents on one hypervisor terrace demands 500 discrete physical chips, costing $22,500 in dedicated silicon.
